GPTR-F-001-S73.title: Execution Pipeline Integration Enforcement Gate
GPTR-F-001-S73.description: Integrate allowlist enforcement into GPTReader execution flow to guarantee validation occurs before any MongoDB query or data access is performed, preventing bypass paths.

GPTR-F-001-S74.title: Standardized Enforcement Error Response Contract
GPTR-F-001-S74.description: Define and implement a consistent error response schema for rejected requests including reason codes, safe messaging, and no data leakage to ensure predictable client handling and security compliance.

GPTR-F-001-S75.title: Allowlist Enforcement Audit Logging
GPTR-F-001-S75.description: Log all enforcement decisions (accepted/rejected requests, rule violations, request metadata) to support auditability, SIT validation, and security review without exposing sensitive payload data.
